The IRAC images were obtained from the Set of Enhanced Imaging Products (SEIP), which is part of the Spitzer Heritage Archive.
We used the `gpu-uvmem` package (cite: Casassus2006ApJ...639..951C; Carcamo2018A&C....22...16C) to minimise the objective function,
These were subtracted in the $uv$ plane, handling the raw (non-gridded) visibility data with the `pyralysis` package (cite: casassus_carcamo2022MNRAS.513.5790C).

all_quotes.loc: Point-source subtraction in the IRAC images
all_quotes.quote: Star subtraction was performed using ` StarXTerminator`, an AI-based tool that employs neural networks to remove stellar sources from astronomical images.
